steps.text: Use the banana palm in the east of Rookgaard to get a banana.
steps.source: Head to the Bananapalm located in East Rookgaard. "Use" the Bananapalm to get the Banana.

steps.text: Give the banana to Willie in the town.
steps.source: Head to Willie in the town and trade the 'Banana' for a Studded Shield.

steps.text: Willie gives you a studded shield.
steps.source: Willie: A banana! Great. Here, take this shield, I don't need it anyway.
